text: The Page Builder interface allows users to create custom pages using a drag-and-drop interface instead of writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Content can be created directly in the UI and edited using the MOLGENIS web forms. Elements can also be reordered and deleted.

To get started, go to the [page gallery](/apps/ui/cms/pages), click the "add new page" button and select the "new landing page". Enter a name for the page and save. Your page will now be listed in the gallery and you can click on the "edit" button to start building your page.

With the page builder, you can create landing pages such as a home page, about us page, or a contact us page. The idea behind these pages is that content is stored in a system of blocks (e.g., sections) and content is placed inside these blocks (e.g., heading, paragraphs, images). This system allows for extensive flexibility in how you create pages as content can be reused in more than one block and blocks can be used in multiple pages.

Page builder components have additional settings that can be enabled or disabled. For example, you can apply a shaded background on blocks (like this one) to provide a visual separation between multiple blocks. By default, this option is disabled. To enable it, click on the edit button to modify any section and enable the "apply shaded background" button.

For text elements (e.g., headings, paragraphs) it is only possible to center the text within a block. URLs can be created within a paragraph by writing them in markdown format. You can also create email links by adding the "mailto:" prefix to the URL. To see an example, click the edit button for this paragraph and view the following email: [support@molgenis.org](mailto:support@molgenis.org)
